status: Observed CPU workflow and native presentation passed. The exact image fails the security gate with four fixable CRITICAL OS-package vulnerabilities; PR release acceptance is withheld.

source.binding_scope: Verified actual file bytes inside the image, exact digest in all six rendered tasks and a running workload container; this is not a substitute for full image byte/security/licensing qualification.
source.evidence_revision_relation: Evidence-only privacy/history correction; runtime producer remains b18 and image remains 9263. No newer package/image bytes are claimed.

execution.route: Standard npa.workflow via SkyPilot managed jobs on Kubernetes

dataset.name: Open3D DemoICPPointClouds, Redwood RGB-D living-room1 fragments
dataset.kind: synthetic indoor benchmark fragments from augmented ICL-NUIM; real workload execution, not a fresh physical sensor capture

numeric_lineage.method: Independently loaded original PCDs, applied retained registration graph poses as NumPy points @ R.T + t, cast to float32, and compared every decoded fragment position; all exact. Compared all fused positions, mesh vertices and triangle indices against actual PLYs. Check ran inside exact image with network disabled.

surface_measurements.interpretation: Distance from observed samples does not prove fabricated surface. Sparse coverage of a correct closed cube also triggers this measure; deciding geometric correctness requires an independent reference surface.

capture.method: Unedited whole native window captured through X11 after loading the actual workflow RRD
capture.independent_visual_review: Both actual panes retain the complete displayed geometry, observed colors and visible partial surfaces; no tooltip, error dialog or provenance panel blocks the view. Software renderer banner retained.

limitations: The mesh is partial, has visible holes, and is not watertight, edge-manifold or vertex-manifold.
No collision readiness, physics validity, full-scene reconstruction accuracy or general quality claim.
No independent hosted VLM evaluation or GPU/performance result is claimed in this pack.
The exact current image fails its security gate. Complete byte/licensing qualification and required CI are separate gates; this successful runtime is not a release authorization.

Operational originals, including the RRD, are privately retained because they contain infrastructure metadata; hashes identify their exact bytes. The public screenshot is unchanged and the report is explicitly an allowlisted derived summary.
The documentation branch privacy/history correction is independently accepted at 9e6b58458; this runtime pack does not assert current PR merge readiness.
A target image-pull credential had to be delivered before the managed workload recovered; workflow success does not prove shipping preflight catches that issue.
Synthetic benchmark input does not establish accuracy on physical sensor data or robot deployment usefulness.

image_security.required_next_step: Scoped pinned package/snapshot correction and notice delivery, new immutable source/image, fresh complete qualification and applicable replay. Existing runtime proof stays bound to old 9263 bytes.
image_security.findings_scope: Unchanged image-security policy findings; individual exploitability is not asserted.
